jobs.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Art-direct a sophisticated 16:9 high fidelity Chinese historical narrative game interface proposal. Edit the attached screenshot as a reference for the SAME Weiyan face, black headwrap, red robe, worn armor, evening camp and position. Keep character and scene visible, face entirely unobscured. Replace the whole bottom UI with a more elegant carefully aligned dialogue/reply composition. Very dark charcoal translucent ink wash, subdued grey-brown texture, ivory text, thin muted bronze rules, small cinnabar confirmation button. NO bright beige or yellow paper. Absolutely NO inventory, items, objects, bags, wine cups, item tabs, attached-object chips, phone, mind map, drag canvas. Only CLUES recording information. Remove all 物品 labels and all 随附 labels from reference. No whole-screen form. Typography legible consistent KaiTi, actual quote and draft around24px scaled to1440 width, names22px, actions20px, support16px; no huge header. No infographic captions, letters A/B, device frames, watermarks. NPC line is distinct from player reply: separate narrow ink quote band with a discreet cinnabar vertical mark before "魏延", quotation "军情有变，我要面见丞相！". Below is an elegant dark reply writing area with SMALL integrated label "我" (no repeated 对魏延说 / 准备说的话 labels). Use TWO readable draft lines "将军，今夜帐内有禁令。" and "请先把军情交给我，我替您转呈。" Make it feel like answering the visible person, not an administrative form. The writing surface has subtle inset shading and generous padding, not chunky gold frame. Under draft, one quiet context chip "引用：营门禁令 ×". Bottom footer left quiet "AI 润色", secondary "撤销润色" subdued, right "收起" and modest cinnabar "确认说出". Never put a clues insertion button in this bottom footer: the entire clue browsing and insertion interaction must be ABOVE or to the RIGHT of writing area as specified. Scenes and draft text are visual samples only. LAYOUT A, clues ABOVE: all interaction horizontally centered x11%-89%, bottom y53%-96%. Uppermost is slim detached dark clue shelf y53%-64%, with aligned label "线索" at left and small "收起线索" at far right. Middle inline tabs "营门禁令", "斥候回报", "敌军动向", selected first subtle bronze underline. Next single compact preview line "今夜帐内有要事，闲人不得擅入。" and RIGHT aligned small outline button "插入原话". This entire shelf is ABOVE the NPC quote and player reply, separated by a small gap. Then NPC quote band y66%-72%, writing area y74%-87%, footer y90%-95%. A compact horizontally oriented layered composition, no oversized card. Keep clue preview visually secondary, the reply is the primary reading destination. Keep all scene top52% untouched. No clues on right, no duplicate clue footer entry.
